title: "rules for updating the text track rendering" is incompatible with WebVTT implementation
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering is generically defined, of which it states that WebVTT has one such implementation: https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks

However, in step 18 of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#time-marches-on where these rules are invoked, there is a mismatch in arguments provided to the algorithm.

WebVTT expects a "media element" to be passed in directly, on which it filters the respective text tracks. That's also explicitly mentioned in the note at the top:

> All the [text tracks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/embedded-content.html#text-track) that use these rules for a given [media element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/embedded-content.html#media-element), or other playback mechanism, are rendered together, to avoid overlapping subtitles from multiple tracks.

Instead, HTML invokes the algorithm for every single text track, providing the fallback language of each text track uniquely. WebVTT instead wants 1 fallback language for the media element and thus for all affected tracks.

If there is only one implementation of this algorithm (I am not sure if that's true or not), then maybe we can remove the indirection and call https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks directly to make the two algorithms align in terms of arguments and expectations?
